headline: Nasdaq Plunge Triggers Dot-Com Bubble Comparisons Amid Market Selloff
summary: Friday's sharp market decline in the Nasdaq has raised disturbing parallels with the peak of the dot-com bubble in 2000.
why: The Nasdaq is a major global stock market index heavily weighted toward technology and growth companies, making it a primary gauge for investor sentiment in the tech sector.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: The index dropped sharply following Friday's market plunge.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A steep selloff in technology equities drove the index down, evoking historical comparisons to the 2000 dot-com crash.
